subject: Dedicated capacity demo — throughput & latency profile
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nebuladata.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 22:15:00 -0500
Subject: Dedicated capacity demo — throughput profile

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding — we just finished a short self-serve evaluation of Redwood and would like to set up a focused demo on Dedicated capacity. Primary goals: validate sustained throughput at ~5k tokens/sec for our batched inference workloads and confirm tail latency at 95th percentile under burst.

Attached is a one-pager with our QPS and sequence-length mix (nebula_qps_requirements.pdf). Our preferred time windows next week (all ET):
- Tue Mar 12: 10:00–11:00 or 13:00–14:00
- Wed Mar 13: 09:00–11:00

We'll have our ML infra lead (copied below) and a Product Ops person on the call to cover networking/whitelisting. Rough agenda: 20 min infra & capacity, 25 min live throughput run, 15 min Q&A and next steps.

Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering | Nebula Data
[Attachment: nebula_qps_requirements.pdf (1 page)]

Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo — throughput profile

Hi Liam — really appreciate the detail and the QPS doc, that helps a lot. Stephanie (our Sales Engineer) and I can run the session.

Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue 2027-03-12 11:00–12:00
- Tue 2027-03-12 13:00–14:00
- Wed 2027-03-13 10:00–11:00

If any of those work, we'll send a calendar invite and prep notes. We'll also bring a short checklist (network ports, sample payloads) so we can get a throughput run started within the first 10–15 minutes.

I attached our demo ops checklist and will follow up with an invite once you confirm a slot.

Jordan Blake

Jordan, thanks. Can we slot this for Tue Mar 12 at 10:00 PT (that should be 13:00 ET) — the earlier PT time helps our west-coast infra team. Also looping Priya (our solutions lead) from Redwood to make sure the SE coverage lines up.

Two quick notes:
1) We'll need instructions for IP allowlist and any TLS client certs beforehand.
2) Could you confirm if you can simulate our mixed sequence lengths (avg 128 tokens, 5% long tail 1,024 tokens) during the throughput run?

If 13:00 ET works, please send an invite and a short prep doc we can share with our infra team.

—Liam
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 13:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo — throughput profile

Perfect — Tue Mar 12 13:00 ET is confirmed. I've attached a calendar invite and a short prep checklist; highlights below.

Agenda (60 min):
- 5m: intros / success criteria
- 20m: architecture & routing—how Dedicated handles KV cache and batching
- 25m: live throughput run with mixed sequence-length workload
- 10m: next steps & recommended quantization/instance profiles

Prep items for your infra team (please share with Nebula Data Ops):
- Allowlist: 34.195.112.0/22, 52.23.45.0/24 (sample; we'll share definitive list in separate email)
- Ports: 443 outbound; certs: none required for the demo (we use mTLS for Private deployments only)
- Send a small set of sample payloads (JSONL) to ops@redwood.com before EOD Mon Mar 11 so we can pre-warm KV caches

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics; redwood-dedicated-demo-ops-checklist.pdf

Quick reminder — looking forward to the session tomorrow at 13:00 ET. A few items that will make the run smooth:
- Please share sample JSONL (<= 5000 lines) and a short config with per-request token counts by EOD today.
- If you have a synthetic client we should use for steady QPS, include the run command and Docker image tag.
- We'll stream logs and token metrics to a shared Drive during the demo; link is in the calendar invite.

If anything changes, ping me directly and we'll rebook.

Cheers,
